The night before an important product release deadline, the boss asked two of their subordinates, a 45-year-old and a 30-year-old, to stay late to continue working. The 45-year-old was too tired to stay but the 30-year-old continued to work for several more hours. Who was not willing to work more?
A. The 45-year-old
B. Can't be determined
C. The 30-year-old
